title: NIST WebBook: Water is H2O, molecular weight 18.0153 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Water as H2O, molecular weight 18.0153 amu, CAS 7732-18-5.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Water, CAS Registry Number 7732-18-5, lists molecular formula H2O and molecular weight 18.0153 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 18.01056468370 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/H2O/h1H2. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
